a taken name is refused
another person's request key is not aaron's: still refused
the name still resolves to aaron's handle

journeys/a-stranger-cannot-edit-a-page.t.name: a stranger cannot edit a page

steps.title: bob has no page, so he has nowhere to add a link
bob cannot move aaron's link, and the handler never runs
bob cannot remove aaron's link
someone who is not signed in cannot remove it either
someone who is not signed in cannot claim a name
aaron's name resolves, for anyone
bob cannot release aaron's name
aaron's page is exactly as he left it

journeys/add-order-and-remove-a-link.ts.name: add, order and remove a link

steps.title: the page starts with the three links aaron put on it, in order
aaron adds a fourth link
it goes at the end, with its title and address
aaron moves the newsletter to the top
the page shows the new order
a position past the end puts a link last
the page shows GitHub last
aaron removes the talks link
the page no longer lists it, and keeps the order of the rest
he cannot remove it twice
he cannot move a removed link
the page is as the removal left it
a visitor resolves the name to a handle
a visitor reads the page: the name and every link, in order
a signed-in person who is not the owner reads the same page
a name nobody claimed has no page
a name nobody claimed does not resolve
a name nobody has claimed does not resolve
an unclaimed name has no public page
aaron cannot add a link before he has a page
aaron claims the free name
the name now resolves to a handle
the claim made a public page, with no links yet
aaron cannot claim a second name while he holds one
the refused second name is still free
aaron puts a link on his page before he lets the name go
bob cannot release aaron's name
aaron releases his name
he cannot release it twice
the released name no longer resolves
the released name has no public page
aaron has no page to add a link to any more
someone else claims the released name
the new page has none of the old owner's links
the old handle is not bob's: he cannot release it, and it stays released
aaron can claim again: a released handle does not count as one he holds
aaron can add a link again, to his new page
his new page has only the new link, and the old name's page is still bob's and empty
